visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins within a smartphone photo-editing interface, displaying a woman with grey-blonde hair styled with animal-like ear accessories. She is wearing a low-cut red traditional-style garment, leaning forward over a dark wooden counter where several gold coins with paw prints are stacked. Yellow text overlays the top and bottom of the frame, indicating an AI-related topic. (2) A pop-up menu appears in the center of the screen with a progress circle labeled 28%, indicating an AI image expansion task is underway. The background dimming slightly as the interface focuses on the central modal. (3) The image expansion fails, and a message box appears in the center of the screen with white text on a dark background, stating that the image contains sensitive information. The woman in the photo remains static in the background. (4) The camera zooms in closely on the woman's chest and face, highlighting the plunging neckline. The lighting is warm and slightly diffused. (5) A cartoonish male head sticker is placed over the woman's chest area to obscure the cleavage. The editing interface shows white bounding boxes and adjustment handles around the sticker. (6) The AI expansion process is triggered again, showing a loading icon in the shape of a white hexagon on a dark background with a percentage counter. (7) The final result is revealed, showing the woman's image successfully expanded to a wider aspect ratio. The cartoon sticker is removed to show the AI-generated clothing that blends with her original red outfit. Large white characters appear at the bottom indicating 'Success'.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form tutorial demonstrating a workaround for AI image-processing filters. It shows how the creator bypassed a 'sensitive content' restriction in a photo expansion app by using a sticker to cover a revealing neckline, tricking the AI into completing the image before revealing the original subject in the final expanded result.
